description: This file defines the 'EquationInputArea' class, a WPF/XAML code-behind component for managing equation input UI in a calculator app, including color management, focus handling, and event handling for equations and variables.

classes.name: EquationInputArea
classes.description: A partial class implementing the code-behind for the EquationInputArea XAML control, managing equations, variables, colors, focus, and UI interactions.

methods.name: RaisePropertyChanged
methods.description: Raises the PropertyChanged event for data binding updates.

methods.name: OnPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles property change notifications, triggering updates like color reloads.

methods.name: AddNewEquation
methods.description: Creates and adds a new equation to the list, assigning colors appropriately.

methods.name: FocusEquationTextBox
methods.description: Sets focus to a specific equation's text box.

methods.name: OnHighContrastChanged
methods.description: Event handler for high contrast setting changes, reloads colors.

methods.name: ReloadAvailableColors
methods.description: Reloads the list of available colors based on contrast and theme settings.

methods.name: EquationTextBox_Submitted
methods.description: Handles submission of equation text, adding new equations or focusing next.

methods.name: GetViewModelFromEquationTextBox
methods.description: Retrieves the EquationViewModel associated with a TextBox.

methods.name: ToggleVariableArea
methods.description: Toggles visibility of variable slider settings.

methods.name: validateDouble
methods.description: Parses a string to double with fallback default.

methods.name: SubmitTextbox
methods.description: Validates and updates variable values from TextBox input.

methods.name: EquationTextBox_RemoveButtonClicked
methods.description: Removes an equation from the list.

methods.name: EquationTextBox_KeyGraphFeaturesButtonClicked
methods.description: Raises event to request graph features.

methods.name: EquationTextBox_EquationButtonClicked
methods.description: Toggles equation line enabled state.

methods.name: EquationTextBox_Loaded
methods.description: Initializes equation text box, sets focus if needed.

methods.name: EquationTextBox_DataContextChanged
methods.description: Handles data context change, possibly refocusing.

methods.name: FocusEquationIfNecessary
methods.description: Focuses the equation if it matches the target.

methods.name: VariableAreaClicked
methods.description: Toggles variable slider visibility.

methods.name: VariableAreaButtonTapped
methods.description: Handles tap event on variable area button.

methods.name: VariableAreaTapped
methods.description: Handles tap event on variable area.

methods.name: EquationTextBox_EquationFormatRequested
methods.description: Raises event for equation formatting.

methods.name: Slider_ValueChanged
methods.description: Handles slider value changes, with delayed logging.
